title: My Profile
sub: Your data is saved in your account, with a copy on this device.
name: Your name or nickname
addressNote: This changes the Arabic wording. English isn't affected.
missionLengthNote: Short uses the easier version of challenges.
languageNote: Switching doesn't change your progress or mission. Saved messages stay as they are.
motionNote: Stops unnecessary movement. It also applies if your device's setting is on.
soundNote: Nothing relies on sound to be understood.
nextPrayerNote: You enter it yourself, for today only.
protect: Protected time after the call to prayer
wipeQ: Delete all your data from this device?
wipeText: Your points, attempts and messages will all be deleted, and we can't restore them. We don't keep another copy.
cityNote: Choose your city to protect every prayer automatically, or enter the time yourself.
flashCity: City saved. Prayer times are calculated each day.
flashManual: Back to entering the time yourself.
